response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer AS c JOIN Employee AS e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_counts AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average FROM rep_counts), kept AS (SELECT * FROM city_counts WHERE customer_count > city_average), kept_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers FROM kept) SELECT k.City AS city, SUM(k.customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(k.customer_count - k.city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(1.0 * k.customer_count / t.total_customers) AS average_share FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_total AS t GROUP BY k.City
